paragraphs.source_en: The seven autumn grasses adorned the mountain road from Shinano to Mikawa, and from time to time O-Kaede closed her eyes and prayed in silence. She did not intend to bite off her tongue and kill herself on the way—not because she feared death, but because she feared that when Sadamasa heard she had died like that, he would think it meaningless.
